item.title: Why Is epoll So Important? Why Do Nginx and Redis Depend on It?
item.description:
Why Is epoll So Important? Why Do Nginx and Redis Depend on It?

A high-performance server usually needs to handle thousands or millions of connections.

Examples:

  • Nginx
  • Redis
  • Node.js

item.title: What Is a Callback? Why Do epoll, ThreadPool, and Async Programming Need It?
item.description:
What Is a Callback? Why Do epoll, ThreadPool, and Async Programming Need It?

In traditional programming, we usually think:

Call Function

 |

 v

Get Result

Example:

int result = calculate();

The caller controls the entire flow.

But modern systems often work differently.

Examples:

  • epoll
  • thread pools
  • GUI frameworks
  • asynchronous I/O
  • networking servers

They all have one common problem:

We do not know exactly when something will happen.
